meta.name: dispatch
meta.description: Delegate tasks to OpenAI Codex CLI and Google Antigravity CLI from Claude Code. Say 'check with codex' or 'ask gemini for a second opinion' and Claude runs the other agent, keeps a topic-aware session, and critiques the result.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 Claude 调用其他 AI 助手并对比结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 中快速调用其他 AI 助手并获取第二意见
copy.tagline_en: Call other AI assistants from Claude and compare results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly invoke other AI assistants from Claude and get second opinions

howto.what: 安装后，你可以让Claude把任务交给其他AI助手（如OpenAI Codex CLI或Google Antigravity CLI）处理。Claude会运行这些助手，保持对话上下文，并给出自己的分析和评价。
howto.when: 当你在Claude Code中说出“check with codex”、“ask gemini for a second opinion”等指令，或者要求交叉验证、委托任务时触发。

say.text: 用codex检查我未提交的代码改动。
say.note: Claude会运行Codex审查代码并总结结果。
Claude会调用Gemini分析并对比自己的观点。

say.text: 继续之前的codex会话，那个主要问题是真的吗？
say.note: Claude会恢复之前的委托会话并继续讨论。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can ask Claude to delegate tasks to other AI assistants like OpenAI Codex CLI or Google Antigravity CLI. Claude runs the other agent, keeps a topic-aware session, and critiques the result rather than echoing it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like 'check with codex', 'ask gemini for a second opinion', or request cross-checking or task delegation in Claude Code.

say_en.text: Ask codex to review my uncommitted changes.
say_en.note: Claude runs Codex review and synthesizes findings.

say_en.text: Ask gemini to challenge this architecture.
say_en.note: Claude invokes Gemini and compares analysis.

say_en.text: Continue with codex — is the top issue real?
say_en.note: Claude resumes the previous codex session.
